worldcombat.skill.watersport.summary: Spread a puddle on the chosen ground: bodies inside are soaked, their Fire moves are suppressed, flames and burns are put out, and open ground fires are quenched cell by cell. Friend and foe alike.
worldcombat.skill.watersport.use.2: Soak the ground before a Fire volley
worldcombat.skill.watersport.description: Lay the puddle on ground within %1$s blocks.
The puddle has a radius of %1$s blocks and lasts %2$s, soaking every body inside regardless of side.
A soaked body's Fire moves deal %1$s of their power, and stay wet for %2$s after leaving.
Extinguish fire on up to %1$s ground blocks per pulse.
Laying it takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. See the form note for the wide/deep trade-off.
worldcombat.skill.watersport.form.0: Deep: puddle radius x0.75, duration x1.35, Fire factor x0.85 (stronger suppression), at +3 ticks wind-up and x1.15 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.watersport.form.1: Wide: puddle radius x1.3, -2 ticks wind-up, x0.9 cooldown, at x0.72 duration and the base Fire factor.
worldcombat.skill.watersport.timing: Cast on ground within %1$s blocks: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s and the cooldown %5$s from commit.
Deep: radius x0.75, duration x1.35, Fire factor x0.85, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown. Wide: radius x1.3, -2 ticks wind-up, x0.9 cooldown, duration x0.72, base Fire factor.
The partner only considers the puddle while a threat is this close; smaller lays it up close, larger sets it up in advance.
Push the puddle at the foe
On, the puddle is laid between you and the threat so the fighting line is soaked; off, it is laid at your feet to shield yourself first.
On, the puddle is only laid against a Fire-type threat or while a nearby body is burning; off, it is used as standing suppression.
On, a partner holding its post will step out to lay the puddle.
